senses.gloss: f. (מרי II) rebelliousness, rebellion; contempt of court, v. מַמְרֵא II.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 16a:8">Snh. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מהַמְרָאָתוֹ</he> from the Scriptural text treating of his (the elder’s) rebellion.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 14b:7">Ib. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>המראתו ה׳</he> his rebellion is legally punishable; a. fr.—Pl. <he>הַמְרָיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. CVI, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 864:4">Yalk. ib. 864</cite> <he>שתי ה׳ המרו וכ׳</he> they rebelled twice.
